Okay, I'm finally making time to get these pictures up. I'm sure there are better, more official pictures of the costume contest participants, but these are the ones I took.

  • TheJayMann doing a great job as Mister Fixer - I especially love that hat!
  • Two absolutely adorable kids as 2/5 of the Freedom Five (With Adam standing behind them, by chance!)
